<details><summary>Tool use: **run_terminal_command_v2** • Run command: cd C:\Users\tajoh\Git\better-anki && node -e "
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

function getAllKeys(obj, prefix = '') {
  let keys = [];
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    const fullKey = prefix ? prefix + '.' + key : key;
    if (val !== null && typeof val === 'object' && !Array.isArray(val) && Object.keys(val).every(k => !/^\d+$/.test(k))) {
      keys = keys.concat(getAllKeys(val, fullKey));
    } else {
      keys.push(fullKey);
    }
  }
  return keys;
}

function getNested(obj, path) {
  return path.split('.').reduce((o, k) => o?.[k], obj);
}

function setNested(obj, path, value) {
  const parts = path.split('.');
  let current = obj;
  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
    const part = parts[i];
    if (!(part in current)) current[part] = {};
    current = current[part];
  }
  current[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value;
}

const en = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/locales/en/translation.json', 'utf8'));
const enKeys = getAllKeys(en);
console.log('English keys count:', enKeys.length);
console.log('Sample keys:', enKeys.slice(0, 20));

const locales = ['de', 'fr', 'es', 'zh'];
for (const loc of locales) {
  const file = 'src/locales/' + loc + '/translation.json';
  const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
  const locKeys = getAllKeys(data);
  const missing = enKeys.filter(k => !locKeys.includes(k));
  console.log(loc.toUpperCase() + ' missing:', missing.length, missing);
}
"</summary>

const fs = require('fs');

function getAllKeys(obj, prefix = '') {
  let keys = [];
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    const fullKey = prefix ? prefix + '.' + key : key;
    if (val !== null && typeof val === 'object' && !Array.isArray(val) && Object.keys(val).every(k => !/^\d+$/.test(k))) {
      keys = keys.concat(getAllKeys(val, fullKey));
    } else {
      keys.push(fullKey);
    }
  }
  return keys;
}

const en = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/locales/en/translation.json', 'utf8'));
const enKeys = getAllKeys(en);

const locales = ['de', 'fr', 'es', 'zh'];
let allGood = true;
for (const loc of locales) {
  const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/locales/' + loc + '/translation.json', 'utf8'));
  const locKeys = getAllKeys(data);
  const missing = enKeys.filter(k => !locKeys.includes(k));
  if (missing.length > 0) {
    console.log(loc.toUpperCase() + ' still missing:', missing);
    allGood = false;
  } else {
    console.log(loc.toUpperCase() + ': All keys present ✓');
  }
}
if (allGood) console.log('\nAll locales are in sync with English.');
"</summary>

```bash
supabase migration up
```

```bash
supabase db reset
```
